title: Doozy Vape Co Big Drip Lime Slush Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Big Drip Lime Slush from the Doozy Vape Co. is an utterly refreshing and nostalgic slush cocktail with bright, zesty lime notes layered with crushed ice for maximum refreshment. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
